targets.title: Do rural banks matter? evidence from the Indian social banking experiment.
targets.evidence_quote: To replicate the estimates of the effect of the bank branch expansion on rural poverty outcomes, we used the same dataset5 as Burgess and Pande (2005).
targets.outcome_computational_quote: Table 3 (columns 3 to 5) present IV estimates for poverty outcomes, and again, the results are precisely the same as in Burgess and Pande (2005).
targets.outcome_robustness_quote: From a policy perspective, our results indicate that Burgess and Pande (2005) overestimate the effects of bank expansion on elimination of rural poverty .
targets.outcome_reasoning: Original dataset re-analysis explicitly reproduces the IV results exactly. Alternative cut-years undermine the instrument interpretation and materially qualify the causal claim; authors judge the original effects overestimated despite similar coefficients for several cut-years.
